project: Booking three-page split — customer view, booking page, thank-you page

context.app: quotemate-automation (Next.js 16 App Router, React 19, Tailwind v4, vitest, playwright, strict TS)
context.goal: Every funnel becomes: customer view -> Stripe -> /book (calendar only) -> /thanks (video, receipt, add-to-calendar). Today the roofing /book page shows the thank-you video AND the calendar on one page, painting books inline on its quote page, and the quotes funnel is book-first.
surfaces: app/q/[token]/{page,book,paid,thanks}    — electrical, plumbing, solar (via twin quotes row)
invariants: Money path: never display an inferred amount. resolvePaidAmount prefers the recorded Stripe amount_total; the INSPECTION_FEE_AUD fallback is for pre-migration rows only.
Never re-charge: payRedirectTarget checks paid FIRST — /r mints a fresh Session per click, so a paid quote routed to stripe would charge again on every re-click of an old SMS link.
Never charge into an empty calendar: canTakePayment({bookableCount}) gates every mint. Pay-first means the customer commits before seeing times.

The webhook-race guard (confirmPaidFromSession / the roof book page's session retrieve) is load-bearing — a customer who beats the Stripe webhook must still see a confirmation. Keep it on whichever page absorbs success_url.
Bookable windows are always derived with resolveBookingOptions, so the page, the booking API and the payment guard can never disagree and 409 a legitimate pick.
Slot labels render in the TENANT's timezone (tzForState) — a WA evening slot formatted in Sydney shows the wrong day.

QuoteMax design system: warm-charcoal #16120F canvas, single Caterpillar-yellow #FFC400 accent, Manrope + JetBrains Mono, square corners, borders not shadows, Australian English, zero emoji. Dark-on-yellow only — white on the accent is forbidden (~1.4:1).
Keep existing data-testids and aria labels — playwright e2e depends on them.
context.doNotTouchReason: Uncommitted in-flight work by another author, present in the tree at session start. Leave unstaged and unmodified.

stories.title: Task 5 — move the early-booking discount to the Stripe mint
stories.description: CRITICAL: under pay-first the book route's `!alreadyPaid` branch never runs, so without this the early-booking discount silently stops applying for every customer. Add resolveMintDiscount({appliedPct, offerPct, expiresAt, tier, now}) to lib/quote/early-bird.ts returning {pct, stamp}: non-deposit tiers -> {0,false} (never discount the flat $99); appliedPct > 0 -> {appliedPct,false} (already realised, never double-stamp on a re-click); else earlyBirdStatus live -> {discountPct,true}; else {0,false}. Give earlyBirdStatus an optional injectable `now` if it lacks one. Use it in mintFreshDepositUrl in app/r/[token]/[tier]/route.ts, writing applied_discount_pct + applied_discount_at when stamp is true, inside its own try so a pre-migration-044 deploy simply finds no offer. Then delete the whole '// ─── v8 Phase A' block from app/api/q/[token]/book/route.ts along with its now-unused appliedDiscountPct local, PAY_TIERS constant, earlyBirdStatus + expireCheckoutSession imports, and the early_bird_discount_pct response field.
acceptance: early-bird.test.ts covers: live offer realised; already-realised kept without re-stamp; lapsed ignored; inspection never discounted; missing offer ignored
app/api/q/[token]/book/route.ts no longer imports earlyBirdStatus or expireCheckoutSession

Then build app/q/[token]/thanks/page.tsx and app/q/roof/[token]/thanks/page.tsx: force-dynamic server components that load the row, run the same webhook-race guard the current /paid and roof /book pages use, switch on thanksPageTarget, and on 'render' show — in order — TrustVideo with trustVideoUrls(identity).thankyou and caption 'A thank-you message from your tradie', a next-steps paragraph, BookedSummary, AddToCalendar, and a 'Download quote (PDF)' link when priced.
